source_text: WHO maintains that FGM confers no health benefits and inflicts immediate risks including severe bleeding, excessive pain, shock, and urine retention, alongside long-term consequences such as recurrent infections, cysts, infertility, complications during childbirth (including increased risk of newborn deaths), chronic pain, sexual dysfunction, and psychological issues like depression and anxiety. [1]
